[[File:Marissa.png|thumb|250px|Marissa]] '''Marissa''' (Japanese: '''マサミ''' ''Masami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared alongside her older brother {{OBP|Mateo|EP087}} in ''[[EP087|The Crystal Onix]]''. Marissa had thrown a bottle in the ocean with a letter in it asking if anyone knew about the [[Crystal Onix]], and that, if they had, to come see her on [[Sunburst Island]]. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} happened to come across the letter and headed for the island. When they found her, she was being terrorized by one of the other shop owners, who said that Mateo should just close up the shop. Unfortunately, Ash did not know anything about the Crystal Onix but did offer his help. Marissa is a sweet girl who looks up to her brother and is always willing to help him. Even though Mateo didn't believe in himself at times, she always did. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=こおろぎさとみ ''[[Satomi Koorogi]]'' |en=[[Tara Jayne]] |ar=فدوى سليمان ''Fadwa Souleimane'' |fr_eu=Lydia Cherton |no=Katrine Blomstrand |pl=Anna Dąbkowska |pt_br=Daniella Piquet |es_la=Rossy Aguirre |es_eu=Isatxa Mengíbar}}
